name: Filesystem and Disk I/O Errors
description: Catches kernel errors from EXT4, XFS and Btrfs and block layer I/O errors (Buffer I/O error, I/O error on a sector). A failing disk logs many of these at once, so it alerts at most every 30 minutes.
match_pattern: EXT4-fs error|XFS \([^)]+\): (?:metadata I/O error|log I/O error|Corruption)|BTRFS (?:error|critical)|Buffer I/O error on dev|I/O error, dev \S+, sector
